# netCDF4 1.7.5 wheels require macOS 15 (Darwin 24). Use compatible wheels
# on older runners; the Homebrew source build fails the mgrid round trip.
netCDF4<1.7.5; sys_platform == "darwin" and platform_release < "24"
# Block simsopt 1.11.0 wheels with unsupported AVX-512 instructions.
simsopt!=1.11.0
